segments.an3.49:1.3: Anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya ātappaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya ātappaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsanāya ātappaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
segments.an3.49:1.4: Imehi tīhi, bhikkhave, ṭhānehi ātappaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
segments.an3.49:2.1: “Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya ātappaṃ karoti, anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya ātappaṃ karoti, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsanāya ātappaṃ karoti.
segments.an3.49:2.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ātāpī nipako sato sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā”ti.

lines: Anuppādāyāti anuppādatthāya, anuppādaṃ sādhessāmīti iminā kāraṇena kattabbanti attho.
Ettake ṭhāne satthā āṇāpetvā āṇattiṃ pavattetvā idāni samādapento yato kho, bhikkhavetiādimāha.
Ime ca pana ātāpādayo tayopi lokiyalokuttaramissakā kathitā.
Tāsaṃ yathāvuttānaṃ adhivāsanāya pahātabbadukkhavedanānaṃ pajahanaṃ nāma khamanamevāti āha “khamanatthāyā”ti.
